Incident postmortem: the expired certificate

On February 3, our TLS certificate expired. From 09:12 to 09:59 UTC, 47 minutes in total, 18% of requests failed. That's a real impact and I won't downplay it.

The certificate passed its expiration date without anyone noticing, because we had no expiry alert. We only found out when users ran into errors.

Service was fully restored by 09:59. The incident also showed us where our monitoring had a gap.

Our top priority now is adding certificate expiry monitoring and alerts, so renewals become routine and don't catch us off guard again.
